name: arbeitnow
description: Arbeitnow: a job board for jobs in Germany (remote, visa sponsorship, English speaking). This CLI searches and filters jobs, lists a company's jobs, reads the free public job-feed API, opens job details and lists hiring companies.

commands.name: search-jobs
commands.summary: Search jobs by keyword, with optional tag, location/category, date-posted filter, sort order and page. Returns paging info plus the result list as rendered HTML; each <li data-slug> holds a job slug a

params.name: search
params.description: Keyword query, e.g. 'python developer'. Empty means all jobs.

params.name: tags
params.description: JSON array of tag slugs, e.g. ["remote"]. Use [] for no tag filter.

params.name: category
params.description: Location/category slug, the same as /jobs/locations/{slug}. Examples: 'remote', 'berlin', 'munich'. Empty means any.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sort order. 'null' is the site default; 'relevance' sorts by relevance; 'newest' puts the most recent first.

params.name: date_posted
params.description: Posting-date window. Observed values: 'all' and '7d'. The UI likely also offers '24h' and '3d'.

commands.name: list-company-jobs
commands.summary: List the open jobs of one company. Needs both the display name and the slug. Returns paging info plus the result list as rendered HTML; each <li data-slug> holds a job slug for get-job.

params.name: company_name
params.description: Company display name exactly as shown on the site, e.g. 'Duck Duck Go'.

commands.name: list-jobs-feed
commands.summary: Free public job-board API feed: newest jobs as clean JSON (slug, company, title, description, remote flag, tags, job types, location, created_at), paginated.

params.name: visa_sponsorship
params.description: Documented on /blog/job-board-api but not exercised: true returns only jobs that offer visa sponsorship.

commands.name: get-job
commands.summary: Get full details of one job posting: title, HTML description, salary, employment type, remote/location, dates and hiring company.

params.name: job_slug
params.description: Job slug ending in the numeric job id, e.g. 'remote-director-data-science-440507'. It is the 'slug' field from list-jobs-feed or the data-slug in search results.

commands.name: list-companies
commands.summary: List the companies hiring on Arbeitnow with their open-job count. The company slug is the last segment of url; use it with list-company-jobs.

notes: search-jobs and list-company-jobs return JSON whose 'data' field is a rendered HTML fragment of <li data-slug=...> items. Each item's data-link is the job URL /jobs/companies/{company_slug}/{job_slug}. Pass those two parts to get-job.
For clean structured JSON without keyword filtering, use list-jobs-feed (the public, keyless /api/job-board-api). Its 'slug' field is the job_slug for get-job; the company slug is in the 'url' field.
tags must be a JSON array string, e.g. ["remote"]. category takes a location slug from /jobs/locations/{slug}, e.g. 'remote'.
/visa-sponsorship-jobs and /remote-jobs redirect: visa sponsorship goes to the home page, remote goes to /jobs/locations/remote. Use category=remote or the feed's visa_sponsorship parameter instead.
No login needed. Every command is read-only; analytics events on stats.arbeitnow.com are skipped.
